payload.text: I saw Romain with the wolves last night. I swear it.
A child "saw" something in the dark? She wants us to kill an innocent.
Romain helped me all day. Chloé is too sure of herself.
Chloé shouts the loudest. That is suspicious.
Chloé was the little girl. She told the truth about Romain.
Zoé defended me just to look reasonable. She is playing us.
Zoé, you voted with the wolves' side yesterday.
Romain is with us. Look at Zoé instead.
